scope: Qualitative structure only. No real speedway mu, peak slip ratio, optimum angle or post-peak falloff calibrated from these sources.

sources.title: Mitas SPEEDWAY
sources.use: Speedway product and footprint/carcass description; no usable force-slip surface calibration.

sources.title: Altair Soft Soil Tire Model 2025
sources.use: Pressure-sinkage, shear-displacement, lateral bulldozing and multipass structures; no numerical transfer to shale.

sources.title: Naranjo 2013, Virginia Tech
sources.use: Controlled low-speed single-wheel soil experiments show sinkage/slip dependence; not a speedway tyre dataset.

sources.title: McIntyre 2015, Auburn
sources.use: Combined-force measurements on prepared remolded clay varying slip angle, camber, pressure and load; relevant experimental design, not shale calibration.

sources.title: Project Chrono Terrain Models
sources.use: Distinguishes scalar friction handling queries from deformable terrain interaction; no recommendation to implement SCM/DEM now.
